jobs.occupation: Customer Service Officer: English + Czech + Polish OR Lituanian - Multiple shifts - Oostakker
jobs.description:
For our client we're looking for a Customer Service Officer.In this role, you become the voice of support for drivers facing unexpected vehicle issues across Europe. You'll be part of a fast-paced and multilingual contact center where your communication skills, empathy, and sense of urgency play a crucial role in keeping transport moving. 

 
• Handle incoming assistance requests from international customers experiencing roadside vehicle breakdowns. 
 
• Take ownership of each case by coordinating with local service providers and technicians until the issue is resolved. 
 
• Maintain constant communication with both the customer and service partner, providing regular updates and reassurance. 
 
• Think on your feet and apply a proactive approach to problem-solving, often finding creative solutions under time pressure. 
 
• Be an integral part of a tight-knit, multilingual team that thrives on collaboration and mutual support. 
 
• Operate within a 24/7 environment, where teamwork and flexibility are essential to ensuring seamless customer experiences. 

- You speak and write fluently in English + Czech, and Lithuanian and/or Polish 

 
• You are service-driven and naturally inclined to go the extra mile to support customers in stressful situations. 
 
• Strong interpersonal skills help you adapt your communication style to various cultural and professional contexts. 
 
• You enjoy working in a diverse team setting and are always ready to help others succeed. 
 
• Flexibility to work in a rotating shift schedule, including nights and weekends. 
 
• A hands-on mentality with a structured and solution-oriented mindset. 
 
• Eagerness to continuously develop your skills and embrace new challenges.

Blue Pimento is looking for a Business Analyst 

 

Blue Pimento is looking for a Business Analyst to support the design and continuous improvement of processes and tools for both individual and professional customers in finance/insurance.

 

Key Responsibilities

• Business Analysis: Gather, analyze, prioritize and document business requirements, translating them into functional specifications, user stories and process flows.

• Process Optimization: Assess existing processes, identify improvement opportunities and contribute to digital transformation initiatives, including partner portals, automation and self-service solutions.

• Solution Design & Implementation: Work closely with business, IT, architecture, operations and compliance teams to design suitable solutions, support user acceptance testing (UAT) and facilitate change management.

• Stakeholder Collaboration: Organize workshops and presentations, engage key stakeholders and ensure that transformation initiatives meet business objectives.

• Agile Delivery: Actively contribute to team activities, backlog management and Agile ceremonies, promoting Agile values and principles.

 

YOUR PROFILE 

·       Proven experience as a Business Analyst (+ 5 years).

·       Bachelor in information technology, software engineering, computer science, or related field

·       Familiarity with Agile methodologies, backlog management tools and team ceremonies.

·       Strong analytical and communication skills, with the ability to understand diverse stakeholder needs while maintaining a global perspective.

·       Ability to engage stakeholders, influence decisions and build commitment.

·       Fluent in English and either French or Dutch.

 

OUR OFFER

In addition to a complete salary package that includes a choice of several benefits that you can pick depending on your personal expectations, we offer the opportunity to join an experienced team of people who share a dedicated interest in Information Technologies.

 

BLUE PIMENTO COMPANY PROFILE

Dynamic Consultancy services firm with a human scale, based in Mont-Saint-Guibert, Belgium, Blue Pimento is dedicated to development and deployment of business-oriented platforms. We help mid-sized companies in maximizing the business value of their information systems changes. 

The success of Blue Pimento is based on Quality & Flexibility of the work performed by its consultants and most of the repeating assignments results from our customer's confidence.

 

Interested? Send your application to admin@bluepimento.eu .

jobs.occupation: Customer Service International - EN, IT, SPA, GER
jobs.description:
Are you customer-focused, organized, and eager to work in an international environment? In this temporary Customer Service role, you'll manage orders, coordinate with customers and logistics partners, and ensure an outstanding customer experience from start to finish.

Bedrijfsomschrijving

Our client is a leading international organization operating within the pharmaceutical and health-related sector. Supporting customers across Western Europe, they are known for their commitment to quality, innovation, and customer satisfaction. To strengthen their Customer Service team, they are looking for a temporary colleague who can help maintain their high service standards.

Omschrijving

• Manage customer orders from entry to delivery.
• Communicate with customers, warehouses, and sales teams.
• Handle returns, claims, and transport-related issues.
• Resolve customer inquiries and identify effective solutions.
• Maintain accurate documentation and ERP administration.

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.
• 1-3 years of experience in customer service or administration.
• Familiarity with ERP systems, ideally Microsoft Dynamics or Axapta.
• Fluent in English; Spanish, Italian of German are a strong plus.
• Proactive, detail-oriented, and able to perform under pressure.

You will work as part of a team on the further development and optimization of applications using a modern version of .NET & Angular, with a strong focus on performance, testing, and clean code. You ensure stable communication between various internal systems.Beyond your operational involvement, you will also have input into the broader technical direction. Within the team, you will have the opportunity to initiate technical improvements and actively contribute to building a robust and future-proof IT environment.

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in IT (or equivalent through strong experience)
• Senior professional experience with .NET
• At least a first hands-on experience with Angular
• You're a pragmatic team player
• You work in English and understand Dutch & French

This large Belgian company plays a key role and manages an extensive and technically complex network. Behind the scenes, high-performing and reliable IT systems ensure that operational processes run safely and efficiently. Within this business-critical environment, significant investments are being made in modern software development and sustainable IT architecture.You will join an experienced team operating in an Enterprise environment where quality, collaboration, and long-term vision are central.
Jobomschrijving
You will contribute to the development and optimization of applications that support operations with real-time data & feedback. You will implement new features and improve existing modules within a modern frontend stack where performance, reliability, and usability are key.You will also support the team with your technical expertise in Angular, helping maintain high standards in code quality, maintainability, and reusability. You will collaborate closely with backend engineers, UX specialists, and product stakeholders in an Agile/Scrum environment to deliver robust and scalable enterprise applications.

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in IT (or equivalent through strong experience)
• Senior professional experience with Angular & front-end development in general
• Experience in Java-environments
•  10 years of experience in IT
• You're a pragmatic team player
• You work in English and understand Dutch & French

The company is a not-for-profit making organisation which represents large, medium and small companies across Europe.

Jobomschrijving

Mission of the role:

In this role, you will provide efficient support the Executive Director Innovation in the execution and achievement of his tasks primarily in area of agenda management and email communications.

The successful candidate will frequently interact with high level internal and external contacts and assistant the Executive Director in the daily management of the Innovation team.

Are you inspired by these responsibilities?

For the Executive Director, you will:

• Independently manage his agenda and efficiently co-ordinate the arrangement of meetings, travel, etc.
• Sort emails, answers questions within the framework of certain instructions; transfer more complex issues to the appropriate persons in absence of the Executive Director
• Organize and manage all logistical elements related to international/internal/external meetings, presentations, seminars, events, visits….
• Provide general administrative support within broad guidelines (e.g. making presentations, translating letters and documents).
• Manage the Extranet/Website.
• Perform basic accounting tasks of specific budgets
• Provide support with HR-related issues including onboarding new team members.
• Ensure the administrative interlink with the other  departments.

Can you make the difference?

The successful candidate will be an experienced professional who demonstrates the following experience and competencies:

• A minimum of 5 years of work experience, preferably as an assistant at senior management level
• Excellent written and oral communication skills
• Proficiency in IT, web management and social media skills
• Excellent level of English, written and spoken. Knowledge of other languages is an asset.
• Full proficiency in Microsoft Office tools (Excel, Word, PowerPoint)
• Excellent time management and organisational skills with the ability to prioritise work accordingly
• Excellent interpersonal skills and customer orientation
• Understanding of underlying issues and proactively developing and evaluating solutions

We connect the brightest minds in Europe to make industry greener, smarter and truly sustainable.

Jobomschrijving

Primary responsibilities project management support (50%):

• Creating timelines and contributing to effective planning of funded project activities.
• Monitoring budgets of EU-funded projects and tracking team members’ time dedication consistently, systematically, and coherently.
• Supporting team members in completing tasks, drafting, and submitting reports.
• Oversee and implement the communication and dissemination tasks of projects.
• Support organising conferences, events, meetings, and other activities linked to projects.
• Providing communication support to Processes4Planet projects.
•  
• Communications activities and providing value to members (50%)
• Create a yearly Communication Plan and track its implementation,
• Manage and enhance the Association’s external communication channels (website, social media, newsletters, etc.), 
• Operate members-only collaboration tools (e.g. SharePoint),
• Manage internal communication with company members by operating the existing tools or suggesting new ideas.
• Generate and write content for social media, news releases, newsletters, bulletins, etc.
• Prepare presentations and small publications and manage relations with providers.
• Support to facilitate networking activities 
• Organise participation in external conferences, and support with organization of internal events (conferences, workshops, webinars, etc.).

Qualifications and experience:

Degree in project management, communications, public relations, business administration or related studies.

Minimum 3 years of experience in positions dealing with the tasks described for this position, with excellent performance.

Experience with EU funds is an asset.

Your key skills:

An energetic person with a hands-on approach, task-oriented with attention to detail

Team player with a cooperative spirit

Ability to work in a small core team and diverse virtual teams with people across organizational boundaries and several countries/regions.

Outstanding organisation and prioritization skills with a capacity to retro plan and fulfil strict deadlines.

High-quality results and output oriented.

Capacity to work with complexity and to juggle a variety of tasks flexibly and proactively.

Creative problem-solving skills, able to anticipate needs and deliver your work autonomously

Technical skills and languages:

Strong skills in Word, PowerPoint, Excel and collaborative online tools (e.g. SharePoint).

Experience in project management.

Excellent spoken and written English. Other languages are an asset.

You will contribute to the development and optimization of applications that support operations with real-time data & feedback. You will implement new features and improve existing modules within a modern frontend stack where performance, reliability, and usability are key.You will also support the team with your technical expertise in Angular, helping maintain high standards in code quality, maintainability, and reusability. You will collaborate closely with backend engineers, UX specialists, and product stakeholders in an Agile/Scrum environment to deliver robust and scalable enterprise applications.

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in IT (or equivalent through strong experience)
• Senior professional experience with Angular & front-end development in general
• Experience in Java-environments
• +10 years of experience in IT
• You're a pragmatic team player
• You work in English and understand Dutch & French

• 
Trilingual: Fluent in English, Dutch, and French (essential! ). 
• 
Skilled and Professional: Strong administrative, linguistic, and interpersonal abilities. 
• 
Self-starter: Comfortable working independently and managing multiple tasks. 
• 
Well-presented: Classic, professional attire required (no casual wear). 
• 
Reliable and Organized: Punctual, detail-oriented, and proactive. 
Your Responsibilities: 
You are entrusted with overseeing daily operations and ensuring the smooth running of our services. Your duties will include, but are not limited to: 
• 
Welcoming and assisting clients, visitors, and suppliers (EN/NL/FR). 
• 
Managing communications: Answering phones professionally and routing calls as necessary (EN/NL/FR). 
• 
Office Operations: Handling incoming and outgoing mails/packages, filing, data input, and client file management. 
• 
Client Support: Coordinating meeting room and event requests, arranging lunches, and preparing new client offices. 
• 
Problem-Solving: Addressing customer requests, issues, and complaints promptly and professionally. 
• 
KYC – Handling client files in accordance with our obligations under anti-money laundering regulations. 
• 
Administration and Commercial Support: Control, update, and complete client files/data. Process new requests, conduct visits, and be the key to successful new collaborations through meticulous commercial support. 
• 
Facility Oversight: Performing daily checks of common areas, ensuring a tidy and functional workspace, managing stock, and handling kitchen appliances. 
• 
Administrative Reporting: Providing regular reports to management and overseeing office supplies and operations.

- Language, administrative, and interpersonal skills are essential. 
- Computer proficiency: Solid knowledge of Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, etc.). 
- Multitasking ability: You manage responsibilities efficiently and gracefully. 
- Team player mentality: Though you work independently, you enjoy regular contact with clients and colleagues. 
- Professional ethics: You respect the company, maintain confidentiality, and demonstrate appropriate behavior toward colleagues, management, clients, and partners. You know where the boundaries lie.
 

- Commitment: Understanding the responsibilities and requirements associated with a small organisation in a competitive sector.
 

- Punctuality
 

- Working remotely is not possible for this position.
 

- Dress code in line with the neutrality policy – classic and professional attire.
